title: Slosh King Arena
description: A top-down view of a circular stone arena with purple and teal flooring, centered around a glowing cracked hexagonal platform labeled 'Slosh King'. The outer ring features large pink and yellow crystals on the left, glowing green crystalline structures and pillars on the right, scattered golden rings, and small figures near the top stands.
